questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the booking service and the pricing engine share fare data? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Two requests for the same route and date arrive 10 seconds apart, and the first fetch succeeded. How many times does PricingEngine call FareSource.fetchBaseFare?
choices: Twice, because each booking needs a fresh fare
Once, because the second call returns the cached FareQuote while it is younger than QUOTE_TTL_MS
Once per traveler tier, because the cache key includes the tier

questions.prompt: The payment gateway call succeeds but bookings.insert throws. What does BookingService.book do?
choices: Retries the insert until it succeeds
Lets the error propagate, leaving a charge with no booking record
Returns the record anyway because the charge succeeded

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes how the loyalty module is coupled to the rest of the code?
choices: It depends on PricingEngine to read cached quotes
BookingService depends on it only through discountRate and the TravelerProfile type; it knows nothing about fares
PricingEngine calls discountRate when computing totals
It writes discounted fares into the BookingRepository
